title: AMLO’s Son López Beltrán Says the FBI Is Trying to Buy “Witnesses” to Incriminate Him and His Father
author: SinEmbargo Staff
content:
_This article by SinEmbargo Staff originally appeared in the[November 3, 2026
edition of SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4897982/lopez-beltran-niega-
vinculo-corrupto-con-amilcar-olan-y-acusa-campana-en-medios/), an independent
Mexican digital news outlet._

**Mexico City, November 3 (SinEmbargo).—** **Andrés Manuel López Beltrán**
charged that agents of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (**FBI**) went all
the way to Argentina to offer protection and immunity to **Fernando Farías
Lagunas** , a former Navy officer involved in a fiscal fuel-smuggling
(_huachicol fiscal_) network, in exchange for cooperating against him and his
father, [**Andrés Manuel López
Obrador**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/amlo/), former president of Mexico.

At the same time, he denied having intervened to favor **Jorge Amílcar Olán
Aparicio** with government contracts, and denied that he is involved in [fuel
trafficking](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4858446/las-6-claves-para-entender-el-
caso-de-fernando-farias-y-la-red-de-huachicol-fiscal/).

> “Let me be clear: I have never spoken with any official of the Navy
> Ministry, either directly or by phone or by any other means, and the person
> who mentions me, and who also does so while admitting that he has no
> evidence, was arrested in Argentina, and US FBI agents went all the way
> there to offer him and his family protection and immunity in exchange for
> cooperating with a foreign country against me, against Andrés Manuel López
> Obrador and against the Government of Mexico,” he asserted.

> [View this post on
> Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfSJ4TNtA2c/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)

Through a [video](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfSJ4TNtA2c/?hl=es) shared on
his social media, López Beltrán denied having any relationship of complicity
with Amílcar Olán or being his front man, and said he has no relationship with
him at all.

> “It doesn’t hurt to clarify, as we did more than two years ago, that we
> never had knowledge of, nor interceded for or recommended anyone to obtain
> any kind of contract or business with the Federal or Local Public
> Administration. We are not the same, we are not influence peddlers, nor do
> we take part in any act of corruption, as they intend to accuse us of
> without evidence,” he stated.

In addition, he explained that he met the businessman some years ago in
Villahermosa, Tabasco, through mutual friends, and detailed that at the time
the businessman was dedicated to the sale and distribution of finishes,
flooring, natural stone and construction materials, with no business
relationships with any level of government.

![Fernando Farías, nephew of the former Navy
secretary](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/11/02-fernando-farias.jpg)Fernando Farías, nephew of the
former Navy secretary, was transferred from Argentina to Mexico. Photo: FGR

The son of former president López Obrador also categorically rejected any link
to the crime of fiscal fuel smuggling and said there is no evidence whatsoever
that could prove his participation in or relationship with those illicit
activities.

> “There is not and never will be any evidence that implicates us or that can
> prove our participation or relationship at any level with this crime. We
> have never taken part in it, we never knew about it, and we would never have
> looked the other way if we had known. It is a vile lie and a slander,” he
> said.

## López Beltrán Denounces a Smear Campaign

On this point, he maintained that the accusations are politically motivated
and attributed the attacks to those who, he said, lost privileges with the
arrival of the Fourth Transformation in the federal government.

> “All of this is motivated by political interest. These attacks come from and
> are directed by those who were previously in power, and I don’t mean the
> parties or politicians who pretended to be in charge of the country, but
> those who truly ruled and wielded power: the potentates, the richest men in
> Mexico, the oligarchy, the great corrupt ones,” he said.

![Ricardo Salinas Pliego, owner of TV Azteca](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/11/03-salinas-pliego.jpg)López Beltrán included Salinas
Pliego among those responsible for an alleged smear campaign. Photo: Edgar
Negrete Lira, Cuartoscuro

In this regard, the Morena member directly accused journalist Ramón Alberto
Garza, businessman Ricardo Salinas Pliego, owner of TV Azteca, and commentator
Carlos Loret de Mola of leading a campaign of slander against him and his
father, with the aim of damaging his public image.

> “I directly accuse Ramón Alberto Garza, who acts as an agent of foreign
> agencies in Mexico, Ricardo Salinas, owner of TV Azteca, Carlos Loret de
> Mola, who is always at the service of those corrupt people, and other media
> of manipulation, of leading, participating in and coordinating a campaign of
> slander against us,” he charged.

According to López Beltrán, the discontent of these sectors stems from the
fact that under the new political project they had to pay taxes, abide by the
law and respect national sovereignty, which is why they would seek to recover
the privileges that, he said, they previously had.

Finally, López Beltrán said he will continue to defend his political
convictions despite the accusations and warned that he will not give in to
criticism.

> You will keep accusing, lying, trying to deceive, but we will keep fighting
> as we have done all our lives, and remember what Andrés Manuel López Obrador
> once told you: history has yet to judge you and us. We are not afraid of
> you. We will not bend.
>
> Andrés Manuel López Beltrán
